sentences.text: Wrenfold outperformed Fennick-Base on the unseen test set, with macro-F1 differences of 1.5 percentage points on both Banking (93.1% vs. 91.6%) and Travel (92.4% vs. 90.9%).

The advantage generalized to all three held-out domains, with larger macro-F1 differences of 4.5 points on Insurance (85.7% vs. 81.2%), 3.5 points on Telecom (83.9% vs. 80.4%), and 4.2 points on Utilities (86.2% vs. 82.0%).

These descriptive results suggest Wrenfold's advantage extends beyond the training domains and may even increase there, though no statistical tests were reported and only three held-out domains from this corpus were evaluated.
